headline: Ministry of Finance raised over 6 billion hryvnias from bond sales: where the money will go
summary: The Ukrainian Ministry of Finance raised 6.07 billion hryvnias in a regular auction of domestic government bonds. The funds will go to financing the Armed Forces and maintaining financial stability.
why: Domestic government bond auctions are how Ukraine funds its budget. Auction results indicate domestic demand for sovereign debt and the government's financing conditions.
